run_check_include_guards: run the script to check all C/C++ header files for valid preprocessor include guards
run_check_include_guards_fix: run the script with --fix flag to automatically correct invalid include guards in header files
run_check_include_guards_precommit: run the script with --precommit flag to check only files changed in the current git commit
build_valid_guard: build the expected preprocessor include guard name from a given header file path
check_GuardValidator: check a single header file for correct ifndef/define/endif preprocessor guard structure using GuardValidator
